purpose: Teach: 上方/封印/軌跡/骨格/懐疑/名門/先入観/取り除く

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業績、上方修正、株主、喜ばれそうだな、社員にも、ボーナス、出せるよう、調整しろ。
lines.en: Performance is up. Shareholders will be pleased. Let's adjust the budget so we can give staff bonuses.
lines.style: Direct, measured delivery. Clipped sentences. Decisive tone on each instruction. No pause for agreement — it's already decided. Eyes forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。過去のスキャンダル、すでに、封印された案件です、もう、議論する必要、ないかと、存じます。
lines.en: Yes. The past incident was sealed long ago. I don't think there's any need to revisit it.
lines.style: Careful, methodical phrasing. Respectful formality beneath the surface. Choosing words precisely, as though closing a file. Steady tempo, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社の軌跡、社史として、若手にも、伝えていきたい、創業者の精神、絶対、忘れさせるな、絶対。
lines.en: Our company's history needs to be something we pass on to the younger staff. The founding spirit — absolutely don't let them forget it.
lines.style: Shift to conviction. Slower, more measured. Weight behind 'absolutely' — not harsh, but firm. Pauses between phrases like planting stakes. Almost philosophical in cadence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。製品の骨格となる、コア技術、新人にも、引き継いでいきます、技術伝承、徹底中です、最近。
lines.en: Yes. We're making sure to hand down the core technology that forms the backbone of our products to new hires. We're being very thorough about technical knowledge transfer lately.
lines.style: Engaged, slightly earnest. Taking pride in the detail. A touch faster on the practical points, showing warmth toward the process itself. Confidence without overstatement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の動向、懐疑的に、見つつ、当社の戦略、進めろ、楽観だけは、絶対、禁物だ。
lines.en: Keep moving the strategy forward, but stay skeptical about industry trends. Optimism alone is absolutely not an option.
lines.style: Harder edge returns. Measured but firm. The word 'absolutely' lands with quiet weight. Not a threat — a principle. Brief pauses underline each key point.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。名門企業との提携、来期、進める予定です、当社の、ブランド、強化されますね、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. We're planning to advance the partnership with that prestigious company next quarter. It will really strengthen our brand.
lines.style: Upbeat but grounded. Genuine warmth at 'really strengthen' — showing belief in the outcome. Natural pace, collaborative tone. Not overselling, just affirming.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お客様の先入観、商品で、覆していく覚悟、社員、持って欲しい、製品開発に、活かせ。
lines.en: I want the staff to have the resolve to overturn customers' preconceptions through the product itself. Put that into product development.
lines.style: Slower, more deliberate. The word 'resolve' carries weight — aspirational, not just directive. Pauses for breath. Sounds like he's transmitting something important, not just giving orders.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。製品から、ムダを、取り除く取り組み、進めております、コストカット、効率化、本格化中です。
lines.en: Yes. We're actively removing waste from the product design and ramping up cost efficiency across the board.
lines.style: Brisk, energetic on the operational details. Shows momentum and engagement. Clean delivery, no uncertainty. Slight lift at 'across the board' — momentum building.
